grants.description: Verify your identity using your passport or national identity card, and provide a digital photo of your face
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing your EU Settlement Scheme application

grants.description: Provide your fingerprints if you do not have a valid biometric residence card
grants.purpose: To verify your identity if you do not have a biometric residence card or it expired more than 18 months ago

grants.description: Allow the Home Office to check your National Insurance number against HMRC tax records and DWP benefit records to verify your continuous residence
grants.purpose: To automatically verify how long you have been continuously resident in the UK, reducing the need for you to provide documents

grants.description: Allow the Home Office to access your travel records to verify dates you entered and left the UK
grants.purpose: To verify your continuous residence and check for absences that may affect your eligibility for settled or pre-settled status

grants.description: Allow the Home Office to check UK and international criminal databases for convictions, and declare any convictions that appear in your criminal record
grants.purpose: To assess whether you have committed serious or repeated crimes, or pose a security threat, which may affect your eligibility

grants.description: Provide documents proving your continuous residence in the UK if automated checks are insufficient
grants.purpose: To prove you have been continuously resident in the UK for the required period

grants.description: Provide documents proving your family relationship to an EU/EEA/Swiss national, if you are applying as their family member
grants.purpose: To prove your eligibility to apply as the family member of someone from the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein

grants.description: Allow the Home Office to check the settled or pre-settled status of your EU/EEA/Swiss family member
grants.purpose: To verify that your family member has the required status under the EU Settlement Scheme

grants.description: Provide evidence explaining why you are applying after the deadline, if applicable
grants.purpose: To assess whether you have reasonable grounds for the delay in applying to the scheme

revocation.mechanism: Contact the EU Settlement Scheme Resolution Centre or revoke through your UKVI account
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before a decision is made. If you have settled or pre-settled status, revoking consent will not affect your status, but may affect your ability to prove it or update your details.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make decisions about your criminal record declaration without your explicit review. Agent cannot submit biometric data on your behalf - you must attend UKVCAS in person if required. Agent cannot appeal a decision on your behalf. Agent cannot confirm domestic violence or abuse circumstances without safeguarding assessment. Agent cannot apply for a child without explicit parental or guardian consent for each child. Agent cannot change your claimed nationality or family relationships without your confirmation.
